_doc: Mods (docs/BOARDING.md, B4; scripts/board/mods.gd): small devices worn in a kit slot, like FTL's augments. A mod has three tiers (Mk I to III); every tier is its own cargo item `<id>_mk1..3` of kind `mod` in data/items.json (slot `kit`), so the hold, loot and shops carry them like anything else. A person wears up to boarding.json kit.mod_slots of them. scope `party`: the best one worn by anyone in the boarding party counts, they do not stack; scope `self`: it works for the wearer only. does: the line the hover and the item's card show (8 words at most). color: the mod's colour in the HUD, the loot list and the icon. weight: its share of the mod drops. tiers[i]: the numbers of Mk i+1 (`text` is the line of the hover; the other keys are read by the code of the mod: spotter_cam depth (doors deep), glow (the light of the feed, 0-1) and tracker (foes standing still in those rooms still ping); salvage_rig bonus (x the stack) and rare_chance (per container, one extra rare material from `rare`); overcharge_coil damage (+share), size (x the bolt's width and light) and pierce (bodies the shot goes through after the first); `stat` is the row of the item's card). resources: what the Salvage Rig multiplies besides every material (`extra`: the rounds, credits); never blueprints, parts, weapons or gear. drops: how loot picks a mod (the `mod` outcome of the tables in boarding.json): `stages` is a list of {from, w: [Mk I, Mk II, Mk III]}, the weights of the tiers from that stage of the run on; Mk III is rolled only in the site kinds of `tier3_kinds`. Ship mods (a `ship` slot) are left for later: no ship slots exist yet.

mods.name: Spotter Cam
mods.does: Shows the rooms behind nearby doors, dimly.
mods.blurb: A shoulder camera that patches into the site's own. It sees what the dark would keep from you.

tiers.text: 1 door deep, brighter. Foes there ping the tracker, even standing still.
2 doors deep, bright. Foes there ping the tracker.

mods.name: Salvage Rig
mods.does: Opened containers give more of every stack.
mods.blurb: A harness of clamps and a loader's patience. Whatever you open comes out heavier.

tiers.text: +100% of each stack, and 1 in 3 containers add a rare material.

mods.name: Overcharge Coil
mods.does: The wearer hits harder; bolts burn bigger.
mods.blurb: A coil wound round the grip. The gun hates it and hits harder for it.

tiers.text: +45% damage, and the shot goes through the first body.
